title: Indexed lookup reconstructs a list
statement: For every list $G$ of conjunctive normal form formulas over natural-number variables, mapping the indices $0,1,\ldots,|G|-1$ to the corresponding entries of $G$, with the empty formula as the default for an out-of-range lookup, yields $G$ itself.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a list of conjunctive normal form formulas over natural-number variables
replaced: For every list $L$ of CNF formulas, the list obtained by looking up the entries of $L$ at indices $0,\dots,|L|-1$, with the empty formula as default for out-of-range lookups, is $L$ itself; the default is never used at a legal index.
